I took my dog ​​for a bath and grooming and was absolutely impressed with the care and dedication of the team. She was there for about four hours, during which they patiently and lovingly detangled her fur, without needing to cut more than necessary. They did the breed-specific cut, trimmed her nails, and took care of every detail with great professionalism.

At the end, they even put an accessory on her head and gave her biscuits — a lovely touch!

All this for about 50 euros, which seemed super affordable for the work and time they dedicated. Furthermore, they told me that if I go there more often I'll start getting discounts on future visits, which is great!

My dog ​​left perfect and happy, and I left completely satisfied. I recommend them 100%!
Thank you very much, Eduardo!
